items.title: Expanding economic opportunity with AI
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. Learn how we’re expanding economic opportunity and making AI skills more accessible.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出全新的就业平台（Jobs Platform）与认证体系（Certifications），旨在帮助劳动力市场对接工作机会、培训资源和相关技能认证，从而扩大经济机遇并普及AI技能。原始信息显示：OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. items.title: Welcome EmbeddingGemma, Google's new efficient embedding model
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: 谷歌发布了全新的多语言嵌入模型EmbeddingGemma。该模型拥有3.08亿参数、2K上下文窗口，支持超过100种语言，专为端侧设备和移动端RAG（检索增强生成）流水线设计。在量化后内存占用小于200MB的情况下，它在MTEB同体量文本嵌入模型中名列前茅，为开发者提供了高效且实用的开源文本向量化工具。
